svg.title: We broke the guard. Its cited test noticed.
svg.desc: Curated source mutations, tested independently in disposable copies. Filled circles mean the cited test passed before mutation and failed after it. Hollow circles mark disclosed limits, not tested guarantees. Dashes mean a different package owns that row.
svg.text: We broke the guard. Its cited test noticed.
32 / 32 listed mutations caught · pristine cited tests passed first · actual executed records
This catalog challenges selected claims; it does not prove every comment true or every guard covered.

svg.text: Outside these guarantees — keep these limits visible
Fixture-sensitive packing is not general memory quality.
Local role labels are not an authenticated release service.
Whole-trial totals do not measure patients enrolled in a country.
Healthy work can alert before its next verifiable milestone.
